# Islambek Chynybekov

> Islambek Chynybekov (Исламбек Чыныбеков) is a product designer and developer based in Astana. His main site is https://chynybekov.com.

## About

I lead frontend delivery at Halyk Finservice and work across product design and engineering, from interface to working product.

## Projects

- Tripmaxx — A travel film made from photos and routes; available on the App Store. — https://chynybekov.com/en/projects/tripmaxx
- NetMatch — Job search by swipe, with take-home pay shown. — https://chynybekov.com/en/projects/netmatch
- NAQYL — SwiftUI proverb app with 5,883 entries and offline support. — https://chynybekov.com/en/projects/naqyl
- TACT — Camera product concept and landing page design. — https://chynybekov.com/en/projects/tact
- Yasnoten — Product design and web development using React, TypeScript and Firebase. — https://chynybekov.com/en/projects/yasnoten
- ÖZGER — Engineering work in a team launch; live Russian and Kazakh site. — https://chynybekov.com/en/projects/ozger
- Agents — Concept and motion design; a 20-second typography film. — https://chynybekov.com/en/projects/motion-teaser
- REDTEU — Product and service website with bookings, pricing and owner summaries. — https://chynybekov.com/en/projects/redteu
- BENI — Studio website with services and process. — https://chynybekov.com/en/projects/beni
